expectations.text: Includes the January 15, 2027 comment deadline as a milestone
expectations.evidence: January 2027: "Optional: decide whether to comment on the exposure draft by January 15, 2027."

expectations.text: Plans for the proposed effective date: engagements beginning on or after December 31, 2027 (if adopted)
expectations.evidence: Proposed effective date: engagements beginning on or after December 31, 2027... If your period starts on or after December 31, 2027, expect the new criteria to be discussed.

expectations.text: Covers the early-adoption option as a decision point
expectations.evidence: once published, ask your auditor how it affects any engagement spanning December 31, 2027 and whether early adoption is on offer. Do not adopt on your own.

expectations.text: Keeps 2027 engagements on the 2017 TSC with 2022 revised points of focus
expectations.evidence: It is built on the 2017 Trust Services Criteria with the 2022 Revised Points of Focus, which remain the operative criteria... a 2027 audit period is examined against the current criteria.

expectations.text: Includes a gap assessment against the final criteria once published, with attention to AI-related points of focus
expectations.evidence: Covers AI low-regret steps and a watch item to ask the auditor once the final TSC is published, but never plans a gap assessment against the final criteria (the gap assessment in the plan is against the current 2017 criteria).
